name: ListUtils
description: Advanced list manipulation utilities — index-based pops, condition-based pops, zip, group-by, and set difference. Uses JSON serialization for generic structure support.

structures.name: Condition
structures.description: A single filter condition used by the multi-condition actions (List_PopByConditions, List_PopMultipleByConditions, List_PartitionByConditions, List_ReplaceWhere). Groups a property path, a comparison operator, a comparison value and a case-sensitivity flag into one first-class OutSystems Structure so callers no longer need to hand-craft a JSON string.

attributes.name: Path
attributes.description: Property path to check on each list element. Supports nested paths with dots (e.g. 'Address.City') and array indexing (e.g. 'Tags[0]', 'Items[-1].Name'). CamelCase fallback is applied per segment.

attributes.name: Operator
attributes.description: Comparison operator name. Prefer the constants on the ListUtils.Operators helper class (Equals, NotEquals, Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterOrEqual, LessOrEqual). Symbol aliases '!=', '>', '<', '>=', '<=' are also accepted. Empty defaults to Equals.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.description: The value to compare against, as text. Numeric operators parse this as a decimal with InvariantCulture.

attributes.name: CaseSensitive
attributes.description: When true, string comparisons are case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive. Ignored by numeric operators.

structures.name: TextItem
structures.description: One Text value. Integration Studio has no List-of-Text parameter type, so Text lists (property paths, key names, JSON chunks) are passed as a Record List of TextItem.

actions.name: List_Pop
actions.description: Removes an element at a specific index from a JSON list. Returns the removed element and the updated list as JSON.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: Index
inputs.description: The 0-based index of the element to remove

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The JSON array without the popped element

outputs.name: PoppedElementJson
outputs.description: The JSON element that was removed

actions.name: List_PopMultiple
actions.description: Removes multiple elements at specified indices from a JSON list. Returns the removed elements and the updated list as JSON.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: IndicesToPop
inputs.description: Comma-separated 0-based indices to remove (e.g. '1,3,5')

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The JSON array without the popped elements

outputs.name: PoppedElementsJson
outputs.description: The JSON array of elements that were removed

actions.name: List_PopByCondition
actions.description: Pops the first element matching a property condition. Returns the popped element and modified list as JSON.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON string

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to check. Supports nested paths with dots (e.g. 'Address.City') and array indexing (e.g. 'Items[0]', 'Tags[-1]'). CamelCase fallback applied at each segment.

inputs.name: TargetValue
inputs.description: The value to filter by (as a string, e.g. 'true' or '5')

inputs.name: ComparisonOperator
inputs.description: Comparison operator: Equals (default), NotEquals, Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterOrEqual, LessOrEqual. Empty = Equals.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, string comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive. Ignored by numeric operators.

inputs.name: SearchFromEnd
inputs.description: When true, searches from the end of the list backwards (pops the LAST match). When false (default), searches from the beginning (pops the FIRST match).

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The updated JSON list without the matched element

outputs.name: PoppedElementJson
outputs.description: The single JSON object that was matched and removed

actions.name: List_PopMultipleByCondition
actions.description: Pops all elements matching a property condition. Returns the popped elements and modified list as JSON.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON string

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to check. Supports nested paths with dots and array indexing (e.g. 'Items[0].Name').

inputs.name: TargetValue
inputs.description: The value to filter by

inputs.name: ComparisonOperator
inputs.description: Comparison operator: Equals (default), NotEquals, Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterOrEqual, LessOrEqual. Empty = Equals.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, string comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The updated JSON list without any matched elements

outputs.name: PoppedElementsJson
outputs.description: The JSON array of all items that were matched and removed

actions.name: List_PopByConditions
actions.description: Pops the first element matching multiple conditions combined with AND/OR. Returns the popped element and modified list as JSON.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON string

inputs.name: Conditions
inputs.description: List of Condition Structures. Each entry has Path, Operator, Value, CaseSensitive. Build with the ListUtils.Operators constants (e.g. Operators.Equals) for compile-time safety.

inputs.name: LogicalOperator
inputs.description: How to combine conditions: 'AND' (default) - all must match; 'OR' - at least one must match. Empty = AND. See ListUtils.LogicalOperators.

inputs.name: SearchFromEnd
inputs.description: When true, searches from the end of the list backwards (pops the LAST match). When false (default), searches from the beginning (pops the FIRST match).

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The updated JSON list without the matched element

outputs.name: PoppedElementJson
outputs.description: The single JSON object that was matched and removed

actions.name: List_PopMultipleByConditions
actions.description: Pops all elements matching multiple conditions combined with AND/OR. Returns the popped elements and modified list as JSON.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON string

inputs.name: Conditions
inputs.description: List of Condition Structures.

inputs.name: LogicalOperator
inputs.description: How to combine conditions: 'AND' (default) or 'OR'. Empty = AND. See ListUtils.LogicalOperators.

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The updated JSON list without any matched elements

outputs.name: PoppedElementsJson
outputs.description: The JSON array of all items that were matched and removed

actions.name: List_Zip
actions.description: Combines two lists into a single list of paired objects based on matching indexes.

inputs.name: ListAJson
inputs.description: The first JSON list source

inputs.name: ListBJson
inputs.description: The second JSON list source

inputs.name: KeyNameA
inputs.description: Key property label for List A entries in the output

inputs.name: KeyNameB
inputs.description: Key property label for List B entries in the output

outputs.name: ZippedListJson
outputs.description: The combined JSON array of paired objects

actions.name: List_GroupBy
actions.description: Groups a JSON list by a specific property name.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source JSON list

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to group by. Supports nested paths with dots (e.g. 'Address.City'). CamelCase fallback applied at each segment.

outputs.name: GroupedListJson
outputs.description: Grouped JSON array with Key and Items per group

actions.name: List_ZipGroupBy
actions.description: Groups two JSON lists by a shared key value. Each output group contains the Key plus a named array of items from ListA and a named array of items from ListB that share the same key. Union of first-seen keys across both lists preserves ordering. Useful for cogroup / two-list join scenarios (orders + payments per customer, etc.).

inputs.name: ListAJson
inputs.description: The first JSON list

inputs.name: ListBJson
inputs.description: The second JSON list

inputs.name: KeyPropertyA
inputs.description: Property path in ListA that supplies the group key. Supports nested paths and array indexing.

inputs.name: KeyPropertyB
inputs.description: Property path in ListB that supplies the group key. Supports nested paths and array indexing.

inputs.name: KeyNameA
inputs.description: Output field name for the ListA items array within each group (e.g. 'Orders').

inputs.name: KeyNameB
inputs.description: Output field name for the ListB items array within each group (e.g. 'Payments').

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: GroupedListJson
outputs.description: JSON array of groups: [{"Key": <keyValue>, <KeyNameA>: [...ListA items...], <KeyNameB>: [...ListB items...]}, ...]. Items with no key value fall into a single 'Unknown' bucket.

actions.name: List_Difference
actions.description: Finds elements that exist in List A but not in List B (set difference). Matches on a specified key.

inputs.name: ListAJson
inputs.description: The base JSON list

inputs.name: ListBJson
inputs.description: The subtraction JSON list

inputs.name: MatchKey
inputs.description: Property path to match on. Supports nested paths and array indexing (e.g. 'Meta.Id', 'Refs[0].Code').

inputs.name: ComparisonOperator
inputs.description: Comparison operator for key matching: Equals (default), Contains, StartsWith. Empty = Equals.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: DifferenceListJson
outputs.description: The elements in A that have no match in B

actions.name: List_Chunk
actions.description: Splits a JSON list into a list of JSON-string chunks of a fixed size. Last chunk may be smaller. Essential for batching API payloads and throttled loops. Each output entry is a standalone JSON array ready for JSON Deserialize into the caller's Structure List.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: ChunkSize
inputs.description: Maximum number of elements per chunk. Must be >= 1; values <= 0 return an empty list.

outputs.name: ChunksListJson
outputs.description: A list of JSON-array strings — one string per chunk (e.g. ["[..first N..]", "[..next N..]", ...]). The last entry may hold fewer elements than ChunkSize. Empty list when the source is empty or ChunkSize <= 0.

actions.name: List_DistinctBy
actions.description: Filters a JSON list to unique elements based on a property value (first occurrence wins). Works on structures — native ODC Distinct only supports basic types.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path used as the uniqueness key. Supports nested paths (e.g. 'Address.City') and array indexing (e.g. 'Tags[0]'). CamelCase fallback applied at each segment.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: DistinctListJson
outputs.description: The JSON array containing only the first occurrence of each unique key, preserving source order.

actions.name: List_Slice
actions.description: Extracts a subset of a JSON list using Python/JavaScript-style Start/End/Step. Supports negative indices, negative step (reverse), and End <= 0 meaning 'to end of list'.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: Start
inputs.description: 0-based inclusive start index. Negative values count from the end (e.g. -2 = second-to-last). Clamped to the list bounds.

inputs.name: End
inputs.description: 0-based exclusive end index. Negative values count from the end. Special case: End == 0 is treated as 'unspecified' — for positive Step it means 'to end of list', for negative Step it means 'past the beginning' (Python default).

inputs.name: Step
inputs.description: Step between selected elements. 0 is treated as 1. Positive walks forward; negative walks backward (reverse slice, matching Python semantics).

outputs.name: SliceListJson
outputs.description: The sliced JSON array

actions.name: List_Shuffle
actions.description: Randomizes the order of a JSON list using the Fisher-Yates algorithm. Deterministic when Seed is non-zero; otherwise uses a cryptographically-seeded RNG.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.description: Random seed. Use 0 for a non-deterministic shuffle. Any non-zero value produces the same permutation every call (useful for reproducible tests).

outputs.name: ShuffledListJson
outputs.description: The shuffled JSON array. Original source list is not mutated.

actions.name: List_UpdateAt
actions.description: Sets a single property of the item at a given index. Returns the modified list and the previous value of that property.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: Index
inputs.description: 0-based index of the item to modify. Negative values count from the end. Out-of-range indices return the source unchanged and PreviousValueJson = 'null'.

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to update on the target item. Supports nested paths with dots (e.g. 'Address.City') and array indexing (e.g. 'Tags[0]'). Missing intermediate objects are created (arrays are NOT auto-created; if an array indexing step encounters a missing or non-array node, the action returns the source unchanged).

inputs.name: NewValueJson
inputs.description: The new value as JSON (e.g. '"Active"', '42', 'true', '{"City":"Lisbon"}', 'null'). Falls back to a raw string when the value is not valid JSON.

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The updated JSON array with the property changed

outputs.name: PreviousValueJson
outputs.description: The previous JSON value of the modified property, or 'null' when the property did not exist, when the property existed with a JSON null value (these two cases are indistinguishable), or when the index was out of range

actions.name: List_MinBy
actions.description: Returns the element with the smallest value at a given property path. Empty list returns MinValue = '' and MinIndex = -1.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to compare on. Supports nested paths (e.g. 'Meta.Score') and array indexing (e.g. 'Items[0].Qty').

inputs.name: NumericMode
inputs.description: When true, values are parsed as decimals for numeric comparison. When false, compared as ordinal text (case-insensitive).

outputs.name: ElementJson
outputs.description: The full element at the minimum, or 'null' when the source is empty or no item had a value at PropertyName.

outputs.name: MinValue
outputs.description: The raw value at PropertyName for the returned element, or '' when the list is empty.

outputs.name: MinIndex
outputs.description: The 0-based index of the returned element in the source list, or -1 when no element qualified.

actions.name: List_MaxBy
actions.description: Returns the element with the largest value at a given property path. Empty list returns MaxValue = '' and MaxIndex = -1.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to compare on. Supports nested paths and array indexing.

inputs.name: NumericMode
inputs.description: When true, values are parsed as decimals for numeric comparison. When false, compared as ordinal text.

outputs.name: ElementJson
outputs.description: The full element at the maximum, or 'null' when the source is empty or no item had a value at PropertyName.

outputs.name: MaxValue
outputs.description: The raw value at PropertyName for the returned element, or '' when the list is empty.

outputs.name: MaxIndex
outputs.description: The 0-based index of the returned element in the source list, or -1 when no element qualified.

actions.name: List_Aggregate
actions.description: Applies a scalar aggregation over a property. Sum / Avg / Min / Max parse each value as a decimal; Count / CountDistinct work on any value. Missing or non-parseable values are skipped and reported via MatchedCount.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to aggregate on. Supports nested paths and array indexing.

inputs.name: Operation
inputs.description: One of: Sum, Avg, Min, Max, Count, CountDistinct. Case-insensitive. Empty defaults to Sum.

outputs.name: ResultValue
outputs.description: The aggregation result as text. Sum / Avg / Min / Max are decimals formatted with InvariantCulture; Count and CountDistinct are non-negative integers. Empty when no item contributed (e.g. empty source, or numeric op with all non-numeric values).

outputs.name: MatchedCount
outputs.description: Number of items that contributed to the aggregation — items with a non-null value at PropertyName, and (for numeric ops) parseable as decimal.

actions.name: List_Intersect
actions.description: Set intersection A ∩ B on a keyed property. Returns the elements from A whose key value also appears in B, preserving A's original order.

inputs.name: ListAJson
inputs.description: The base JSON list

inputs.name: ListBJson
inputs.description: The intersection JSON list

inputs.name: MatchKey
inputs.description: Property path to match on. Supports nested paths and array indexing.

inputs.name: ComparisonOperator
inputs.description: Comparison operator for key matching: Equals (default), Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, NotEquals, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterOrEqual, LessOrEqual. Empty = Equals.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: IntersectionListJson
outputs.description: The elements in A whose MatchKey has at least one match in B.

actions.name: List_Union
actions.description: Set union of two lists: concatenates A + B and deduplicates by a keyed property (first occurrence wins; A's items appear first).

inputs.name: ListAJson
inputs.description: The first JSON list

inputs.name: ListBJson
inputs.description: The second JSON list

inputs.name: MatchKey
inputs.description: Property path used as the uniqueness key. Empty = dedupe by the whole element's JSON.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: UnionListJson
outputs.description: A + B with duplicates removed by MatchKey.

actions.name: List_SplitAt
actions.description: Splits a JSON list at a given index into a Left (elements before Index) and Right (Index and later) pair.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: Index
inputs.description: 0-based split index. Negative values count from the end. Values <= 0 leave Left empty; values >= list.Length leave Right empty.

outputs.name: LeftListJson
outputs.description: The elements with position < Index (or the empty list when Index <= 0).

outputs.name: RightListJson
outputs.description: The elements with position >= Index (or the empty list when Index >= list.Length).

actions.name: List_Partition
actions.description: Partitions a JSON list into matching and non-matching sublists based on a single property condition. Non-mutating dual of List_PopMultipleByCondition — both sides are returned.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path to check.

inputs.name: TargetValue
inputs.description: The value to compare against.

inputs.name: ComparisonOperator
inputs.description: Comparison operator. Empty = Equals.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, string comparison is case-sensitive.

outputs.name: MatchingListJson
outputs.description: Elements that satisfy the condition.

outputs.name: NonMatchingListJson
outputs.description: Elements that do NOT satisfy the condition.

actions.name: List_PartitionByConditions
actions.description: Partitions a JSON list into matching and non-matching sublists based on multiple conditions combined with AND / OR.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: Conditions
inputs.description: List of Condition Structures.

inputs.name: LogicalOperator
inputs.description: 'AND' (default) or 'OR'. See ListUtils.LogicalOperators.

outputs.name: MatchingListJson
outputs.description: Elements that satisfy the combined condition.

outputs.name: NonMatchingListJson
outputs.description: Elements that do NOT satisfy the combined condition.

actions.name: List_Reverse
actions.description: Reverses a JSON list. Equivalent to List_Slice(-1, 0, -1) but explicit and cheaper.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

outputs.name: ReversedListJson
outputs.description: The reversed JSON array.

actions.name: List_Flatten
actions.description: Concatenates a list of JSON-array strings into a single flat JSON array. Inverse of List_Chunk — feed List_Chunk's output directly and get back the original list. Non-array entries are skipped.

inputs.name: ChunksListJson
inputs.description: A list of JSON-array strings (typically List_Chunk's output). Each entry is a self-contained JSON array. Non-array entries are silently skipped.

outputs.name: FlatListJson
outputs.description: The concatenation of every parsed inner array, in order.

actions.name: List_Sample
actions.description: Returns a random subset of SampleSize elements from the source list, without replacement. Uses the same RNG semantics as List_Shuffle (Seed = 0 → CSPRNG; Seed != 0 → deterministic).

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: SampleSize
inputs.description: Number of elements to sample. Values <= 0 return the empty list; values >= list.Length return the full list in shuffled order.

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.description: Random seed. 0 = non-deterministic (CSPRNG); non-zero = deterministic (System.Random).

outputs.name: SampleListJson
outputs.description: The sampled JSON array of length min(SampleSize, list.Length). Source is not mutated.

actions.name: List_ReplaceWhere
actions.description: Applies the same property update to every element that satisfies a multi-condition filter (AND/OR combination of any number of property comparisons). Returns the modified list and the number of items that were updated.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: Conditions
inputs.description: List of Condition Structures. Same shape used by List_PopByConditions.

inputs.name: LogicalOperator
inputs.description: How to combine conditions: 'AND' (default) or 'OR'. See ListUtils.LogicalOperators.

inputs.name: UpdateProperty
inputs.description: Property path on each matched item to overwrite. Missing intermediate objects are created; array indices must already exist.

inputs.name: NewValueJson
inputs.description: The new value as JSON. Falls back to a raw string when the value is not valid JSON.

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The updated JSON array with every matching element's UpdateProperty replaced by NewValueJson.

outputs.name: MatchCount
outputs.description: Number of elements that matched the combined condition and were updated.

actions.name: List_UpdateMultipleAt
actions.description: Updates the same PropertyName to the same NewValueJson on multiple elements at specified indices. Out-of-range indices are silently skipped.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source list serialized as a JSON array string

inputs.name: IndicesToUpdate
inputs.description: Comma-separated 0-based indices to update (e.g. '1,3,5'). Negative values count from the end. Whitespace around commas is trimmed.

inputs.name: PropertyName
inputs.description: Property path on each targeted item to overwrite. Missing intermediate objects are created; array indices must already exist.

inputs.name: NewValueJson
inputs.description: The new value as JSON. Falls back to a raw string when the value is not valid JSON.

outputs.name: UpdatedListJson
outputs.description: The updated JSON array with the property changed at every in-range index.

outputs.name: UpdatedCount
outputs.description: Number of indices that were in-range and successfully updated.

actions.name: List_ZipMany
actions.description: Zips N lists together into paired objects by matching position. Generalisation of List_Zip to any number of inputs. Output length is the minimum of the input lengths.

inputs.name: ListsJson
inputs.description: A list of JSON-array strings — one entry per input list.

inputs.name: KeyNamesJson
inputs.description: A list of property names — one label per input list, used as object keys in the output. If shorter than ListsJson, remaining lists default to 'Items0', 'Items1', ...

outputs.name: ZippedListJson
outputs.description: JSON array of objects, one per position, each holding one entry per input list.

actions.name: List_ZipManyGroupBy
actions.description: Cogroups N lists by a shared key. Each output group contains the Key plus one named array per input list of items sharing that key. Generalisation of List_ZipGroupBy to any number of inputs.

inputs.name: ListsJson
inputs.description: A list of JSON-array strings — one entry per input list.

inputs.name: KeyPropertiesJson
inputs.description: A list of property paths — position i is the key path applied to items of ListsJson[i]. Supports nested paths.

inputs.name: KeyNamesJson
inputs.description: A list of property names — position i is the output field name for ListsJson[i]'s array within each group. Shorter lists default to 'Items0', 'Items1', ...

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: GroupedListJson
outputs.description: JSON array of groups: [{Key: <keyValue>, <KeyNames[0]>: [...], <KeyNames[1]>: [...], ...}, ...]. Items whose key is null share the 'Unknown' bucket.

actions.name: List_GroupByMultiple
actions.description: Groups a JSON list by N property paths (composite key). Each output group holds one field per key (labelled by KeyNames) plus the matching items. Generalisation of List_GroupBy to any number of key columns.

inputs.name: SourceListJson
inputs.description: The source JSON list

inputs.name: PropertyPaths
inputs.description: Ordered list of N property paths that together form the composite group key. Supports nested paths and array indexing. Missing values fall back to the string "Unknown".

inputs.name: KeyNames
inputs.description: Ordered list of N labels used as the field names for the group keys in the output. Shorter lists default to 'Key0', 'Key1', ...

inputs.name: ItemsFieldName
inputs.description: Field name for the items array within each group. Empty defaults to 'Items'.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: GroupedListJson
outputs.description: JSON array of groups: [{<KeyNames[0]>:<v0>, <KeyNames[1]>:<v1>, ..., <ItemsFieldName>:[...items...]}, ...]. Groups appear in first-seen order.

actions.name: List_ZipGroupByMultiple
actions.description: Cogroups two JSON lists by an N-key composite. Each output group carries one field per key plus one named array per input list of items sharing that composite key. Generalisation of List_ZipGroupBy to N keys.

inputs.name: ListAJson
inputs.description: The first JSON list

inputs.name: ListBJson
inputs.description: The second JSON list

inputs.name: KeyPropertiesA
inputs.description: Ordered list of N property paths in ListA that form the composite group key.

inputs.name: KeyPropertiesB
inputs.description: Ordered list of N property paths in ListB that form the composite group key. Must have the same length as KeyPropertiesA.

inputs.name: KeyNames
inputs.description: Ordered list of N labels used as the field names for the group keys in the output. Shorter lists default to 'Key0', 'Key1', ...

inputs.name: KeyNameA
inputs.description: Output field name for the ListA items array within each group. Empty defaults to 'ItemsA'.

inputs.name: KeyNameB
inputs.description: Output field name for the ListB items array within each group. Empty defaults to 'ItemsB'.

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: GroupedListJson
outputs.description: JSON array of groups: [{<KeyNames[0]>:<v0>, ..., <KeyNameA>:[...], <KeyNameB>:[...]}, ...]. Union of first-seen composite keys across both lists preserves ordering.

actions.name: List_ZipManyGroupByMultiple
actions.description: Cogroups M lists by an N-key composite. Each output group carries one field per key plus one named array per input list of items sharing that composite key. Generalisation of List_ZipManyGroupBy to N keys.

inputs.name: ListsJson
inputs.description: A list of M JSON-array strings — one entry per input list.

inputs.name: KeyCount
inputs.description: Number of key columns N. Determines how many entries per list are consumed from KeyProperties.

inputs.name: KeyProperties
inputs.description: Flat list of M*N property paths in list-major order: entries [i*KeyCount .. i*KeyCount + KeyCount-1] belong to ListsJson[i]. Missing entries default to empty (Unknown bucket).

inputs.name: KeyNames
inputs.description: Ordered list of N labels used as the field names for the group keys in the output. Shorter lists default to 'Key0', 'Key1', ...

inputs.name: ItemsFieldNames
inputs.description: Ordered list of M labels — one per input list — used as the field names for that list's items array. Shorter lists default to 'Items0', 'Items1', ...

inputs.name: CaseSensitive
inputs.description: When true, key comparison is case-sensitive. When false (default), case-insensitive.

outputs.name: GroupedListJson
outputs.description: JSON array of groups: [{<KeyNames[0]>:<v0>, ..., <ItemsFieldNames[0]>:[...], <ItemsFieldNames[1]>:[...], ...}, ...]. Items whose key is null share the 'Unknown' bucket.
